value.rationale: The motivating recent source establishes absence of fixed-site stationarity and a ballistic second moment but leaves the experimentally meaningful full rescaled spatial profile unidentified. A single second moment cannot determine edge peaks or origin cusps. The sharp s=3/2 threshold distinguishes divergent, flat and suppressed ballistic fronts, with explicit constants useful for spatial readout and future finite-time comparison. This is a natural, non-arbitrary classification of the core transport observable, not a renaming or an unmotivated low-dimensional slice.
